area_food_guide.title: Majnu Ka Tilla (MKT) Himalayan Food Trail
area_food_guide.vibe_badge: Delhi's vibrant Himalayan enclave: prayer flags, rooftop river vistas, steaming momo baskets & bohemian student study addas.
area_food_guide.famous_for_summary: Hand-rolled Tibetan Tingmo & Thentuk, crispy pan-fried Kothey Momos, cold spicy Laphing, and rooftop riverfront cafes overlooking the Signature Bridge.
area_food_guide.best_time_to_visit: 3:30 PM – 8:30 PM (Vibrant golden hour rooftop breeze, alleyway shopping & evening cafe buzz)
area_food_guide.nearest_metro: Vidhan Sabha Metro Station (Yellow Line, Exit Gate 2) – 1.8 km (5-7 min by e-rickshaw for ₹15–20), or Vishwavidyalaya Metro Station (Yellow Line, Exit Gate 3)
area_food_guide.parking_tips: Internal alleys are strictly pedestrian-only with zero car access. Park personal vehicles at the Outer Ring Road paid municipal parking lot near Majnu Ka Tilla Gurudwara footbridge, or take the Yellow Line Metro to Vidhan Sabha.

famous_dishes.name: Pan-Fried Vegetable Kothey Momos
famous_dishes.why_famous: Half-steamed, half-crisp pan-seared crescent dumplings stuffed with shredded cabbage, carrots, paneer, and ginger, served with fire-roasted Sichuan chili dip.

famous_dishes.name: Artisanal Tiramisu & Sweet Shiitake Sushi
famous_dishes.why_famous: Layers of mascarpone espresso sponge paired with creative pan-Asian rolled sushi featuring caramelized shiitake mushrooms in sweet soy reduction.

famous_dishes.name: Devil Jhol Momos in Tangy Sesame Broth
famous_dishes.why_famous: Steamed dumplings submerged in a warm, sour, and fiery Kathmandu-style sesame, tomato, and roasted cumin broth.

famous_dishes.name: Tibetan Tingmo with Veg Shamu Gravy
famous_dishes.why_famous: Fluffy, flower-shaped steamed wheat bread buns served alongside a comforting gravy of button mushrooms, tofu, and seasonal greens.

famous_dishes.name: Signature Blueberry Baked Cheesecake
famous_dishes.why_famous: Velvety New York-style baked cream cheese base topped with a luscious mountain blueberry compote, celebrated across North Campus student circles.

venues.name: Wongdhen Cafe
venues.short_description: Multi-story wooden cafe with an aesthetic book corner, serving wood-fired pizzas, pan-Asian sushi, and specialty coffees.
venues.long_description: Wongdhen Cafe is one of Majnu Ka Tilla's most expansive and atmospheric multi-level dining sanctuaries, featuring blonde wood finishes, warm ambient lamps, and cozy reading nooks. Equipped with robust air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, and laptop-friendly charging hubs, it serves as a productive daytime study haven for Delhi University scholars and an energetic evening hub for groups of friends. The kitchen is celebrated for its hand-stretched artisanal garlic breads, wood-fired pizzas, sweet shiitake mushroom sushi, and decadent freshly baked tiramisu.
venues.address_line1: House No. 40, Central Camp, Street No. 1
venues.landmark: Opposite Tibetan Primary School, Near Central Monastery

items.name: Herb Butter & Cheese Hand-Stretched Garlic Bread
items.description: Stone-baked flatbread infused with roasted garlic butter, fresh parsley, and bubbling mozzarella.

items.name: Corn & Spring Onion Crystal Dim Sum
items.description: Translucent steamed dumplings stuffed with crunchy sweet corn kernels, spring greens, and water chestnuts.

items.name: Mexican Paneer Supreme Pizza
items.description: Hand-tossed 10-inch thin crust topped with spiced cottage cheese cubes, sweet bell peppers, jalapeños, and salsa drizzle.

items.name: Creamy Truffle Wild Mushroom Penne
items.description: Penne pasta bathed in creamy parmesan white sauce with button and shiitake mushrooms, finished with aromatic truffle essence.

items.name: Signature Italian Tiramisu Cup
items.description: Traditional recipe layered with espresso-soaked ladyfingers, rich mascarpone zabaglione, and dark cocoa powder dusting.

venues.name: Kunga Cafe and Restaurant
venues.short_description: Tranquil Himalayan-inspired cafe praised for fluffy breakfast platters, open bao, and blueberry cheesecakes.
venues.long_description: Kunga Cafe and Restaurant stands out as a serene culinary gem tucked into Street Number 6 of New Camp in Majnu Ka Tilla. Owned and run with exemplary hospitality, the cafe provides a soothing Nordic-Himalayan wooden interior that shields visitors from the dense market lanes. It is a favored haunt for couples and small student study circles seeking quality espresso, all-day pancake breakfasts, steamed open bao buns, and pristine hygiene. Their dessert counter, featuring house-baked cheesecakes and lemon tarts, enjoys iconic status across the neighborhood.
venues.address_line1: House No. 5, New Camp, Street Number 6

items.name: Crispy Paneer Open Steamed Bao
items.description: Fluffy lotus-leaf folded steamed bao stuffed with crispy panko cottage cheese, pickled cucumber, and sriracha mayo.

items.name: Classic Steamed Vegetable Momos
items.description: Handmade thin-skinned dumplings stuffed with finely minced garden vegetables and local Himalayan herbs.

items.name: Fluffy Banana Caramel Pancakes
items.description: Stack of three golden buttermilk pancakes topped with sliced caramelized bananas, pure honey, and butter dollop.

items.name: New York Baked Blueberry Cheesecake
items.description: Dense, velvety cream cheese cake on a graham biscuit crust, layered with wild blueberry coulis.

venues.name: Signature Cafe Delhi
venues.short_description: Scenic rooftop cafe overlooking the Yamuna River and Signature Bridge with live music, burgers, and pizzas.
venues.long_description: Perched on the 4th and 5th floors of Wongdhen House, Signature Cafe Delhi is acclaimed for offering the most spectacular rooftop vantage point in Majnu Ka Tilla, overlooking the majestic expanse of the Signature Bridge and Yamuna River. With an expansive open-air deck and breezy glass-walled indoor salon, it provides seating for 80 patrons alongside lively acoustic performances on weekend evenings. The kitchen dishes out a crowd-pleasing continental and Asian spread featuring wood-fired pizzas, smash potato burgers, crystal prawn dumplings, and tall dessert shakes.

items.name: Signature Mixed Veg Steamed Momos
items.description: Thin-wrapper dumplings packed with seasonal veggies, shallots, and cottage cheese, served with spicy red chutney.

items.name: Sundried Tomato, Olive & Caper Pizza
items.description: Thin-crust wood-fired pizza slathered with San Marzano pomodoro sauce, kalamata olives, tangy capers, and mozzarella.

items.name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Brownie Shake
items.description: Decadent thick shake blended with roasted peanut butter, dark chocolate fudge, and crumbled fudge brownie chunks.

venues.name: Tee Dee restaurant
venues.short_description: Legendary budget-friendly Tibetan establishment renowned for soul-comforting thentuk, devil momos, and tingmo.
venues.long_description: Operating for more than two decades, Tee Dee is an iconic Tibetan culinary institution situated right in the heart of New Aruna Colony behind the Tibetan Day School. Beloved by generations of Delhi University students and traveling food writers, the restaurant features authentic wooden booths, framed Himalayan photographs, and warm traditional service. Its menu is an uncompromised masterclass in Tibetan home cooking, famed for hand-pulled flat noodle soups (thentuk), fiery devil momos, golden kothey, and steaming cups of salted butter tea.
venues.landmark: Behind Tibetan Day School, Central Alley

items.name: Vegetable Then-Thuk (Hand-Pulled Flat Noodles)
items.description: Square-cut hand-pulled flat pasta simmered in a nourishing broth with julienned radishes, spinach, and ginger.

items.name: Tibetan Steamed Tingmo Breads
items.description: Twin flower-folded soft, spongy steamed wheat buns ideal for dipping into soups and spicy gravies.

items.name: Vegetable Devil Momos
items.description: Pan-fried vegetable momos smothered in a fiery, sweet-and-spicy house chili garlic reduction.

items.name: Authentic Tibetan Butter Tea (Po Cha)
items.description: Traditional churned tea brewed with black tea leaves, yak butter, and Himalayan rock salt.

venues.name: Romeo and Juliet Cafe
venues.short_description: Expansive romantic rooftop with sweeping Signature Bridge views, private cabanas, and spicy devil momos.
venues.long_description: Boasting the title of the largest rooftop terrace in Majnu Ka Tilla, Romeo and Juliet Cafe spans the 5th floor of Tara House (Wing A). Decorated with glowing neon slogans, romantic fairy lights, and curtained wooden cabanas, it is widely celebrated as the primary date-night and celebration destination in North Delhi. The establishment features an open-air deck as well as an air-conditioned lounge, catering to large groups of DU students.

items.name: Devil Jhol Veg Momos
items.description: Steamed dumplings served floating in a spicy, roasted sesame and Sichuan chili-tomato broth.

items.name: Wok-Tossed Teriyaki Veg Udon Noodles
items.description: Thick Japanese wheat udon noodles stir-fried in sweet garlic teriyaki sauce with bell peppers, baby corn, and bok choy.

items.name: Blueberry Elderflower Seduction
items.description: Fragrant elderflower cordial muddled with crushed mountain blueberries, mint, lime, and crushed ice.

venues.name: MACHEN LA Tibet Kitchen
venues.short_description: Monastery-inspired Tibetan cultural restaurant famed for authentic morning buffet breakfasts, gyuma, and herbal stews.
venues.long_description: Nestled near Sopa Kitchen inside Rabsel House, MACHEN LA Tibet Kitchen is celebrated for its deep devotion to traditional Tibetan monastic culture and authentic cuisine. The interiors are decorated with Tibetan murals, thangkas, and hand-carved cedar furniture, creating an unhurried sanctuary away from the hustle of the market.
venues.landmark: Next Street from Sopa Kitchen, New Camp

items.name: Vegetable Tingmo with Shamu Gravy
items.description: Pair of fluffy steamed flower bread rolls served with a comforting rich mushroom and tofu stir-fry gravy.

items.name: Traditional Vegetable Gyuma
items.description: Handmade vegetarian sausage stuffed with roasted barley flour (tsampa), seasoned beans, and mountain spices.

items.name: Steamed Tibetan Cottage Cheese Momos
items.description: Hand-crimped momos stuffed with paneer, minced cabbage, spring onion, and mild ginger.

items.name: Herbal Clove & Ginger Infusion Drink
items.description: House specialty warm brewed mountain herbal beverage flavored with whole cloves, crushed ginger, and honey.
